overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: topics added by an amended notice were unanticipated by the chair, so the Council could discuss them, and the AG only recommended tabling such topics in future.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council discussed topics added by an amended notice posted less than 48 hours before its March 19 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the topics were unanticipated, the Open Meeting Law did not prevent the Council from discussing them during the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the amended notice's topics were not sufficiently specific to inform the public, since they were added less than 48 hours before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because Council President Wondolowski did not anticipate Councilor Golub's questions 48 hours before the March 19 meeting, notice of the meeting was not insufficiently specific.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
